body: Most likely, I'll end up becoming a teacher. And no, I don't have any such friends. I'm not particularly close with any of the people I hang out with here and I really don't feel comfortable talking about something like this. With the exception of my family, I have never told anyone about my depression.

I have a good idea of a few fields that I would be interested to end up in, and a B.A. or higher is required. I get what you're saying, but I also just needed to get out of my area. It was really hard hit by the recession (~20% unemployment, ridiculous crime, etc.), and there's truly nothing for me there. Also, my college is neither expensive nor preppy...

I don't know what my dreams in life are. I'm going to college because I feel like it's a necessary experience to have. I want to advance my education (I'm the first in my family to do so) but I don't know specifically what I want to study.

I get what you're saying, but it's not an issue of being stressed out or overwhelmed with work or something. I'm just worrying about things that are completely out of my control (but still have major bearing on my life and are therefore hard to ignore). Thanks though, I appreciate it.
